# Project Notes

- App: tandem, a mobile-first shared-expense prototype built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Preserve the phone-width interface and responsive mobile behavior; do not add a desktop dashboard.
- Demo groups and expenses persist in localStorage. Firebase Google sign-in is optional and requires values from `.env.example`.
- Use existing patterns and lucide-react icons. Run `npm run build` after code changes when Node.js/npm are available.
